text: Gooberto Benzino, delighted! Smell that? That’s the smell of brand-new floor mats.
Sit inside, touch everything, fiddle with the radio. The car likes it.

optionen.text: Can I take a test drive?
Why does it cost that much?

text: This beauty? Zero to sixty in … eventually! But LISTEN to that horn.
You pick the colour yourself. We paint it while you watch — otherwise nobody believes it.
Of course! Once around the roundabout. Don’t scratch it! Haha! … No, really. Please don’t.
The moment you buy, the road is yours. Well — on loan. The city sees it differently.
Because there are THREE things in there you’ll never need — and those are the ones you want.
Also it pays for my suit. The suit sells the cars, not me.
By all means! Looking is first gear.
And second gear is … well? Exactly. Buying. I’ll wait here. I wait very well.
